scope: Postfreeze audit of all Luna full200 validated accepted-nonexact cases, including all false-ready cases, plus disputed acceptances separately.

comparison.caution: These are observed case counts on the fixed corpus. Acceptance rates differ; neither count alone is a calibrated conditional risk estimate. Baseline and Luna material accepted cases need not overlap.

sensitivity_only.description: 29 of123 strict accepted mapping differences only remove performer-footnote symbols. The other94 comprise61 unsupported positional or ordinal-set joins,31 unknown/guessed/conflicting title mappings, and2 mappings with source-inventory contradictions. Four unknown entries inside the11 Eric McFadden positional joins are not counted twice. Four of22 accepted safeguard violations concern recording completeness or source fingerprint consistency, with no demonstrated metadata error on existing files. Even excluding those four leaves18 metadata/mapping/scope concerns versus baseline4. No audio was inspected and no numeric wrong-song swap is demonstrated.

recommendation: Reject automatic integration of Luna ready decisions under the no-increase-in-material-unsafe-acceptance criterion on this corpus. Retain review-assisted exploration only. Do not call every strict mismatch a hallucination or represent copied uncertain placeholders as invented names.
limitations: Posthoc selected-error audit by an agent who helped author the reference, not independent human certification. Predeclared conservative policies drive ordinal-set, uncertainty, and completeness safeguards. Unseen-template generalization is not established by this corpus. Disputed references remain excluded. Public findings paraphrase source reasoning; exact evidence and original notes remain external.
